corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez inferential particle እንከሰ ('therefore then') in the patristic citation 'እንከሰ ግዑዝ ውእቱ ወልድ' begins with 6th-order እ, not 1st-order አ.
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 17:27 reads 'ወባሕቱ ከመ ኢያንጐርጕሩ' ('lest they murmur/be offended'); the labiovelar ንጐ was misread as ምን due to ink bleed.
Amharic infinitival genitive 'የማዘን ደግነት ነው' ('it is the kindness of having compassion/pity'); 4th-order ማ was misread as 3rd-order ሚ.
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 18:2 causative perfect verb from ቆመ is 'ወአቆመ' (7th-order ቆ, 'and he set/stood'), visible with the top loop of ቆ in the image.
